review_comment: The code sets a session flag indicating password reset without proper authorization verification. An attacker could manipulate this flag to bypass security controls related to password reset functionality. Add authorization checks to verify that the email corresponds to an actual user account before setting the password reset flag.

The code directly uses session data to determine email template type without validation. An attacker could manipulate the session to trigger a password reset email instead of an activation email. Add validation to ensure the session value is legitimate before using it in security-sensitive decisions.
